content.text: The bulk import worker has grown edge cases (custom field mapping, partial row failure, assignee email resolution) but still relies on manual staging runs. Regressions slip into release candidates.

Done when we have an integration suite under workers/import that spins the worker against a test database and fixture CSVs: happy path 100 rows, malformed custom field, unknown assignee skip, 10k-row performance budget under 60s wall time in CI, and poison-message retry. Suite runs in CI on workers package changes.
